summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 9h 35m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five stuck UAE orders investigated. Four confirmed COMPLETED. Order AE260812-57849665 remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after color swap and partial cancellation failure. Parallel Kibana and DB investigation underway to determine next remediation step. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two completed UAE trade-in orders have clawback processes stuck in RUNNING due to Checkout.com card decline. No reusable PC ticket exists. Remediation script pending user confirmation before creation. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA file generated yet. Lock file exists indicating active investigation. Next step: complete parallel fan-out investigation and write RCA with findings. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file found in ticket-rca directory. Ticket has not yet been investigated. Next step: initiate investigation workflow and generate RCA. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — [SEMAG] [STG2] - Trade-up SO Failure
  No RCA file generated — only lock file exists indicating investigation in progress. Next step: complete investigation, write RCA with findings, and clear lock file.

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after Subs/SMC mappings completed. 3 remain blocked on SMC-side: Galaxy A36 device mapping, identity document validation, and product ID mapping. Reuse PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  No RCA content available — file contains residual EOD generation logs, not investigation findings. Investigation may still be in progress. Next step: complete investigation and generate proper RCA. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — Request to allocate 0.01 to the accessory SKU
  No RCA content available — file contains residual EOD generation logs, not investigation findings. Investigation may still be in progress. Next step: complete investigation and generate proper RCA.

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Analysis confirmed Groovy script needs two new @ColumnMethod handlers. Code modification requiring build and deployment. No PC ticket needed. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — Order Refund Failed - Manual Refund
  18 SA refund failure orders under investigation. Parallel fan-out launched for Kibana logs, DB state, codebase trace, and Jira cross-reference. Investigation in progress — RCA pending completion of parallel checks.

Open tickets:

RT-702249 [New] — [SEMAG] [STG2] - Trade-up SO Failure
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3962 [In Progress] — Order Refund Failed - Manual Refund
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAHME-3421 [In Progress] — Request to allocate 0.01 to the accessory SKU
  Todo: Continue investigation.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
